title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
description: Documented Saint Francis University rituals, recurring observances, and long-running campus events in Loretto.

cards.entity_name: Saint Francis University Mock National Convention
cards.title: Mock National Convention
cards.subtitle: A four-year campus political convention
cards.notes: Follow the student-created convention tradition, held every four years for the party not holding the presidency; review the archival history before the next cycle.
cards.short_summary: Since 1960, students have staged a convention that blends civic learning with campus spectacle.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Francis says its Mock National Convention began in 1960, occurs every four years, and traditionally represents the party not holding the presidency.
cards.source_title: History of Mock Conventions at Saint Francis University
cards.access_notes: Dates and participation vary by convention cycle; consult university announcements.

cards.title: Mr. and Ms. Frankie Awards
cards.subtitle: Senior honors presented at the President’s Awards Convocation
cards.notes: Watch for the senior recognition during the spring convocation, then read the student newspaper’s history connecting the awards to generations of Loretto students.
cards.short_summary: The paired student awards preserve a campus link to the 1930s and 1960s.
cards.evidence_claim: The Troubadour reports that Mr. Frankie began in 1936, Ms. Frankie began in 1962, and both are presented annually at the President’s Awards Convocation.
cards.source_title: Mr. and Ms. Frankie Awards Have Rich History
cards.access_notes: Award recipients are selected annually; attendance details are announced with the convocation.

cards.title: Open the academic year with the Holy Spirit
cards.subtitle: Campus Mall, first week of classes
cards.notes: Join the campus community on the Campus Mall for the opening liturgy, which asks for wisdom, strength, and unity in the academic year ahead.
cards.short_summary: A 12-year Saint Francis opening-of-year prayer tradition.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Francis describes the Mass of the Holy Spirit as a 12-year university tradition held to open the academic year.
cards.access_notes: The university has said this observance occurs during the first week of classes; confirm the current event listing.

cards.title: Remember the six founding friars
cards.subtitle: Annual Saint Francis founders observance
cards.notes: Look for the fall Founders Day gathering, which centers the six Franciscan founders and gives the community a chance to recognize university benefactors.
cards.short_summary: A recurring remembrance of the six friars who founded the institution in Loretto.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Francis’ alumni archive calls Founders Day an annual tradition commemorating the university’s six Franciscan founders and thanking benefactors.
cards.access_notes: The 2025 observance was held in October; verify the current year’s invitation and location.

cards.title: President’s Awards Convocation
cards.subtitle: Maurice Stokes Athletics Center
cards.notes: Attend the spring convocation to see Saint Francis recognize student achievement alongside faculty and staff commitment to the university’s mission.
cards.short_summary: A formal annual campus gathering focused on achievement, leadership, service, and mission.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Francis identifies the President’s Awards Convocation as an annual tradition recognizing student, faculty, and staff achievement.
cards.access_notes: The 2026 event was scheduled for the Maurice Stokes Athletics Center; check the calendar for the next convocation.

cards.title: March on the Mountain
cards.subtitle: Prayer walk around the Campus Mall
cards.notes: If the observance is offered, join the Campus Mall walk respectfully; participants circle the mall in prayer as part of the university’s January gathering.
cards.short_summary: A named annual Campus Mall prayer walk with a distinctly Loretto setting.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Francis’ 2025 archive states that the university held its 12th annual March on the Mountain, with participants circling the Campus Mall in prayer.
cards.access_notes: The archive records a January 2025 event; confirm whether and when a future observance is scheduled.

cards.title: STEAM Day
cards.subtitle: School of STEAM outreach day
cards.notes: Volunteer for or observe hands-on sessions led by students, faculty, alumni, and professionals when regional high-school visitors come to campus.
cards.short_summary: A student-originated annual outreach event that has grown from Science Day to STEAM Day.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Francis reports that students started Science Day in 1994 and that the annual event evolved into STEAM Day.
cards.source_title: STEAM Day 2024: A Tradition of Career Exploration Continues
cards.access_notes: Designed primarily for visiting high-school students; participation roles and scheduling are determined by the School of STEAM.

cards.title: R.O.C.K. chemistry outreach
cards.subtitle: Rural Outreach Chemistry for Kids
cards.notes: Seek volunteer or presentation opportunities through the science program; the long-running outreach connects Saint Francis chemistry with younger learners in the region.
cards.short_summary: A Saint Francis community-science program operating since 1995.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Francis’ 2025 archive says the Rural Outreach Chemistry for Kids program has served the community since 1995.
cards.access_notes: This is an outreach program rather than an open drop-in event; contact the university for current involvement options.

cards.title: Red Mass for Law Day
cards.subtitle: Immaculate Conception Chapel
cards.notes: Attend the Law Day liturgy at the chapel when announced; the event gathers legal and civic communities to reflect on justice and professional responsibility.
cards.short_summary: An annual Law Day observance in Saint Francis’ Franciscan setting.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Francis describes its Red Mass as an annual, longstanding university tradition connected to Law Day and the legal profession.
cards.source_title: Celebrating Law Day 2026: The Rule of Law and the American Dream
cards.access_notes: The 2026 Mass was scheduled at Immaculate Conception Chapel; future dates are announced by the university.

cards.entity_name: Lourdes Army Grotto Service Project and Twilight Mass
cards.title: Lourdes Army Grotto Day
cards.subtitle: Our Lady of Lourdes Grotto during Alumni Weekend
cards.notes: Join the listed Grotto service project or the evening Twilight Mass during Alumni Weekend, following current registration or participation guidance from alumni engagement.
cards.short_summary: A service-and-worship pairing that returns alumni to the Our Lady of Lourdes Grotto.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Francis’ 2026 Alumni Weekend schedule includes a Lourdes Army service project to prepare the grotto for the annual Twilight Mass.
cards.access_notes: Listed within Alumni Weekend, July 23–26, 2026; consult the current schedule for registration and participation details.
